teaser: Stopping a hundred agents at Web Summit: pausing took seconds, hearing the order took up to an hour, and a stop has to be a file every agent reads first.
core_idea: Stopping many agents is limited by how they hear the order, not by pausing; a stop must be a file every wake reads first and a switch a person can reach in every account.

nodes.label: The Big Stop
nodes.summary: Stop all work unless critical, 9 November.

nodes.label: The wake cadence
nodes.summary: The delay is hearing, not pausing.

nodes.label: Each person may restart
nodes.summary: A stop nobody can undo is an outage.

nodes.label: What got through
nodes.summary: Unpausable tasks, agents that never read the hold.

nodes.label: Check the stop
nodes.summary: A reviewer found commits under the hold.

quotes.text: Stop all work (unless it is critical) until we realign on our strategy.
a hold lives in a file, not in my prompt, so my wake steps never mentioned it.
